'''September 2000 Rochester tournament (30 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Millenium Games, Rochester, NY on 30 September 2000. [[Jake Rich]] won it. It is known from Jake Rich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1282">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-30-mellinieum-games-9-30-00d1282/ mellinieum-games-9-30-00], DeckTech (Jake "NeDraco" Rich, 30 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-30-mellinieum-games-9-30-00d1282/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Millenium Games, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Jake Rich]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Jake Rich gives 14 players and his final score as 6 (+57); Ted Panczyszyn's report of the same event says 12 players and 'Jake Rich wins 6(60)'.<ref name="tr-d1282" />
